subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should Control UI support hard refreshes and bookmarks on legacy or arbitrary non-tab route prefixes with public assets resolving, or should support stay limited to root, known app routes, configured basePath, and /__openclaw__?
rationale: Source shows a remaining route-prefix asset gap, but fixing it changes the supported URL contract and gateway static-file routing boundary, so automation should not choose that policy alone.

options.title: Support safe public assets on deep routes
options.body: Land a narrow allowlist for known Control UI public assets under supported SPA route prefixes while preserving 404 behavior for unknown static filenames.

options.title: Limit to documented entrypoints
options.body: Declare arbitrary or legacy non-tab prefixes unsupported, document the expected URLs, and close this issue plus linked stale fork work with that rationale.

options.title: Replace the fork PR
options.body: Use the open fork PR only as source context if its approach matches the chosen contract; otherwise close it after opening a fresh narrow replacement.

recommendation.title: Support safe public assets on deep routes
recommendation.body: Land a narrow allowlist for known Control UI public assets under supported SPA route prefixes while preserving 404 behavior for unknown static filenames.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-code routing candidate for the Control UI public-asset URL-contract decision.
